name: Progress M-09M
about: Progress M-09M (2011-004A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MM), launched 2011 Jan 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2011 Jan 29), held fixed
docked to A06581; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
